delete.succeeded: delete task record, not a refund/cancellation
delete.cancelled: not supported; automatic deletion after 24h per get API

input.text_role: parameter flags only; no text-to-3D description support

parameters.weak_validation: invalid text flags can be silently ignored; check GET fields fileformat/subdivisionlevel and downloaded contents/mesh

output.download_container: zip archive regardless of chosen internal format

billing.failed_without_successful_output: not billable according to successful-output rule; preserve terminal usage/error response for audit
billing.subdivision_or_format_price_variation: no variation listed for Seed3D 2.0 in current official pricing table
billing.usage_authority: GET usage.completion_tokens; pricing and account bill remain authoritative for settlement

quota.sharing: per-model, shared across main account and its subaccounts

account_query.auth: Access Key signed request only, not supplied Ark Bearer API key

quota.why_not: No authenticated account balance was measured; same main account can consume elsewhere; billing/quota reporting can lag; runtime requests do not expose an atomic reserve or max_tokens control.
quota.free_only_mode: Account setting exists with eligibility limits and irreversible disable; do not change settings implicitly. Detailed page refers to 500k general allowance, unlike model-specific Seed3D 2M. Current account state is unknown.
quota.readiness: Use user statement as allowance evidence, begin with one job, record actual reported completion_tokens, reserve allowance for unresolved submissions, stop on unanticipated usage/terminal errors; never auto-retry ambiguous POST.

limits.recommended_for_this_work: sequential first trial and deliberate small batches; no need to maximize rate

known_doc_inconsistencies.conflict: One tutorial inline comment describes medium as 100000 while dedicated create API says medium 500000.
known_doc_inconsistencies.resolution: Use dedicated API values and inspect actual returned asset/fields.

known_doc_inconsistencies.conflict: Tutorial says task data retained 24h while dedicated GET says metadata 7 days, file 24h.
known_doc_inconsistencies.resolution: Save response, archive and hashes promptly; do not depend on remote retention.

capability_boundary.research_suite: Official Seed pages discuss part decomposition, articulation and scene composition with multiple views/videos/text.
capability_boundary.production_ark_api: Current creation schema exposes single-image textured/PBR static model generation and two output-spec parameters only. Research claims do not authorize claiming those functions exist in this API.
capability_boundary.semantic_canonical_backside: Not guaranteed from single reference; generated unseen surfaces remain inferred candidates.
capability_boundary.automatic_rights_clearance: Model output licensing does not clear the input reference or character media rights.
